title: Notch Apple Recipe Restored
description: This Datapack adds the Ability to craft Enchanted Golden Apples in Survival Minecraft using 8 Blocks of Gold and 1 Apple.
body:
This datapack reintroduces the ability to craft Enchanted Golden Apples in Survival Minecraft.
Using a classic-style recipe, players can craft one Enchanted Golden Apple by combining 8 Blocks of Gold surrounding 1 Apple in a crafting table.
